summary: CC-0005 B002 implements 5 new packages (secrets/, database/, deployment/, job/, tls/) and extends 2 existing packages (config/, policy/) with Kubernetes API interaction functions. Typed Go client imports for MariaDB, ESO, and cert-manager are properly added. SharedScheme extended. Simulators migrated from unstructured to typed for MariaDB and ESO. Build compiles, vet passes, all unit tests pass. However, 2 blocking spec deviations (IsSecretReady missing expectedKeys parameter, RunDBSyncJob not delegating to job.RunJob), 3 major consistency issues (deployment.go missing error wrapping and re-fetch, missing integration test files for config/ and policy/), and several minor quality issues were found.

architecture_findings.description: IsSecretReady does not implement the specified signature. Spec requires IsSecretReady(ctx, client, namespace, name string, expectedKeys ...string) (bool, error) with validation that all expectedKeys are present in Secret.Data. Implementation only checks Secret existence without any key validation. Reconcilers depending on key-level readiness checking will not get the expected behavior.
architecture_findings.fix: Add expectedKeys ...string parameter and iterate over expectedKeys to verify each is present in secret.Data. Return (false, nil) if any key is missing.

architecture_findings.description: RunDBSyncJob does not delegate to job.RunJob as specified in the plan (task 4.1: 'delegate to job.RunJob'). Instead, it duplicates the entire CreateOrUpdate + SetControllerReference + re-fetch + status-check logic from job.RunJob. This violates DRY and the explicit spec requirement.
architecture_findings.fix: Replace the duplicated logic with a single call to job.RunJob(ctx, c, owner, desired). Import the job package.

architecture_findings.description: Tasks 3.3 and 3.5 explicitly require integration_test.go files with //go:build integration tag for config/ and policy/ packages. These files do not exist. The tasks are marked 'done' in the progress tracker. Unit tests with fake clients exist and cover the required scenarios, but the plan and review criteria require envtest integration tests for every package.
architecture_findings.fix: Create internal/common/config/integration_test.go and internal/common/policy/integration_test.go with //go:build integration tags, envtestutil.SkipIfEnvTestUnavailable guards, and envtestutil.SetupEnvTest, testing actual ConfigMap creation/retrieval against the API server.

issues_found.description: EnsureDeployment returns bare err without fmt.Errorf wrapping. Every other Ensure/Run function in CC-0005 wraps errors with fmt.Errorf('creating or updating %s %s/%s: %w', ...). Import 'fmt' is also missing.
issues_found.fix: Replace 'return false, err' with 'return false, fmt.Errorf("creating or updating Deployment %s/%s: %w", spec.Namespace, spec.Name, err)'. Add 'fmt' to imports.

issues_found.description: EnsureService returns bare err without fmt.Errorf wrapping, inconsistent with all other CC-0005 packages.
issues_found.fix: Replace 'return err' with 'if err != nil { return fmt.Errorf("creating or updating Service %s/%s: %w", spec.Namespace, spec.Name, err) }; return nil'.

issues_found.description: EnsureDeployment does not re-fetch after CreateOrUpdate before checking status. database.go (line 42-44), database.go (line 118-120), and job.go (line 43-45) all perform c.Get() re-fetch before status check. Inconsistent pattern within CC-0005.
issues_found.fix: Add re-fetch: 'if err := c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(deploy), deploy); err != nil { return false, fmt.Errorf("fetching Deployment status %s/%s: %w", spec.Namespace, spec.Name, err) }' before calling IsDeploymentReady.

issues_found.description: hashConfigMapData does not use separators between key and value byte sequences, allowing theoretical hash collisions. Example: {"ab": "cd"} and {"a": "bcd"} both hash byte sequence 'abcd'.
issues_found.fix: Add null byte separators: h.Write([]byte{0}) between key and value writes.

detected_patterns.name: Create-or-update with controller reference and status re-fetch
detected_patterns.applies_when: Implementing a Kubernetes resource ensure/create function that sets owner references and checks readiness status after creation
detected_patterns.description: All CC-0005 Ensure* and Run* functions follow a 4-step pattern: (1) create an empty typed object with Name/Namespace from desired spec, (2) call controllerutil.CreateOrUpdate with a mutate func that copies desired.Spec and calls controllerutil.SetControllerReference, (3) re-fetch via c.Get() to obtain current status, (4) check status conditions or replica counts for readiness. Error wrapping uses fmt.Errorf with %w including resource type, namespace, and name. Functions return (bool, error) for readiness or error for non-status resources.

detected_patterns.name: Typed CRD simulator with condition-type-aware status setting
detected_patterns.applies_when: Adding a new typed simulator for an external CRD that was added as a typed Go module dependency (i.e., not using unstructured)
detected_patterns.description: Typed CRD simulators follow two sub-patterns depending on the CRD's condition type: (a) For CRDs using standard metav1.Condition (MariaDB Database/User/Grant), use meta.SetStatusCondition(&obj.Status.Conditions, ...) for idempotent condition management. (b) For CRDs using custom condition types (ESO PushSecret, cert-manager Certificate), use a manual find-or-append loop since meta.SetStatusCondition only works with metav1.Condition slices. All simulators: Get typed object, set Ready/Synced condition to True, call c.Status().Update(). The constant conditionTypeReady is shared across simulators.
